general.text: Lifesteal heals at most 5% of max HP per second
details: Area damage against crowds no longer turns lifesteal into full healing every second
Regeneration, shields and other healing are not limited

general.text: Enemies speed up by 1% every five minutes instead of every minute
Enemies push each other apart lightly and no longer stack into one point

changes.text: Lifesteal heals up to 8% of max HP per second instead of the usual 5%
Copies no longer add lifesteal: each extra copy widens the radius by 15%
Several Vampire Hoods in a team do not add up: the strongest one in range applies
